operations.name: safety_baseline_export
operations.summary: Serialize guarded in-memory packages into private validation inputs while preserving source disk and dirty state.

operations.name: runtime_verification_get
operations.summary: Evaluate functional checks and complete diagnostics from one explicit instance and completed PIE session.

operations.name: runtime_smoke_start
operations.summary: Validate a bounded PIE session and actual rendered frame inside a safety_validate worker.

operations.name: runtime_smoke_status
operations.summary: Read durable PIE diagnostics, rendered-frame receipt and completion for one smoke run.

operations.name: safety_validate
operations.summary: Validate asset or PIE/render operations in a copied project, preserving runtime/crash evidence and requiring normal worker exit.

operations.name: bridge_capabilities_get
operations.summary: Read operations supported by loaded bridge modules.

operations.name: batch_execute
operations.summary: Validate then sequentially run a short list of internal operations in one call.

operations.name: task_submit
operations.summary: Queue one internal operation for background execution and return a task id immediately.

operations.name: task_status
operations.summary: Report one background task's status by id, or list all known tasks.

operations.name: task_result
operations.summary: Return the stored full response of a finished background task.

operations.name: task_cancel
operations.summary: Cancel one still-queued background task.

operations.name: viewport_capture
operations.summary: Admit a guarded screenshot job with a unique capture id and durable completion receipt.

operations.name: viewport_camera_get
operations.summary: Read the level editor viewport camera: location, rotation, fov.

operations.name: viewport_camera_set
operations.summary: Move the level editor viewport camera by location / rotation / look_at / fov.

operations.name: viewport_capture_status
operations.summary: Read screenshot completion, producer lifetime and verified PNG identity/dimensions locally.

operations.name: bridge_contract_check
operations.summary: Compare local contract with loaded bridge modules.

operations.name: project_context_get
operations.summary: Read active Unreal project context.

operations.name: workflow_guide_get
operations.summary: Read curated task-level workflow guides by category or keyword query.

operations.name: diagnostics_get
operations.summary: Read UE message-log and asset compile diagnostics.

operations.name: log_tail_get
operations.summary: Read the tail of the current UE project log with optional substring filter.

operations.name: asset_compile
operations.summary: Compile or recompile an asset.

operations.name: asset_validate
operations.summary: Validate an asset.

operations.name: asset_save
operations.summary: Save one asset package directly (never prompts; a read-only file returns save_blocked_read_only).

operations.name: editor_save_all
operations.summary: Save each dirty /Game package directly, prompt-free (read-only files are listed in data.failed).

operations.name: editor_request_exit
operations.summary: Request Unreal Editor exit.
